message.content:
Floss picks holding dental floss: HTS 3306.20.00 is "Yarn used to clean between the teeth (dental floss), in individual retail packages". A stainless steel floss holder is an article of base metal. Likely candidates: 8215.99 (other kitchen/tableware... not apt), 8214.90 (other articles of cutlery, manicure/pedicure sets), or 9018.49 (dental instruments). A reusable stainless steel flosser is a dental tool; CBP rulings have classified similar "stainless steel dental floss holder" under 9018.49.80 or under 8215? Dental instruments and appliances: 9018.49.80 "Other" dental instruments and appliances, other. A floss pick of plastic is classified in 3306.20 as a set with floss. For a metal one with tied floss, which the user supplies, it is a dental instrument: 9018.49.8000 is likely the answer.

{"hts_code": "9018.49.8000", "reason": "A reusable stainless steel holder that secures dental floss for cleaning between teeth is an other dental instrument or appliance of heading 9018, subheading 9018.49.80."}
